Hi, with the help of OpenAI I have crafted a Lean formalization of Rosser–Schoenfeld’s Theorem 12.
The formalization is available for review on Github:
https://github.com/hakonlonmo/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd/tree/rs12-formalization
Under my instruction and supervision, OpenAI successfully verified Theorem 12 with a sorry free audit.

With an interest for math, I find it inspiring that one can prove theorems with Lean. My suggestion is that even though both the design and implementation work was done by OpenAI, the result may be of use to the community. Therefore I share the results.
I would highly appreciate feedback if this kind of formalization is useful, or if it can be considered AI garbage.

Attached is the complete explanation of the proof.
rosser_schoenfeld_theorem12_formalization_rewrite.pdf
